info.name: OpenAgriNet Grievance
info.description:
Grievance and application status capabilities on the OAN network: PM-KISAN and PMFBY.

Import api-collection/OpenAgriNet.grievance-local-environment.json (or ...-cluster-environment.json for the cluster) alongside this and select it, or every {{...-host}} resolves to nothing.

Grievance > PM-KISAN: registry, publish, discover, then file a grievance with an OTP, check it with a new OTP, and the refusals.
Grievance > PMFBY: registry, publish, discover, then lodge a grievance and read the ticket back.
Application status: PM-KISAN payment status, with its own registry, publish, discover and refusals.

Run the folders of each group in order.
